newsitem.title: USA: Zenith Electronics to launch ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: Zenith Electronics to launch ad campaign.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp said Tuesday it hired Bagby and Co Inc to handle its first national advertising program in five years.

"The lack of a national advertising presence since 1992 has affected our top-of-mind awareness, particularly in key demographic segments," said William Sims, president of Zenith's consumer electronics sales and marketing arm.
The company said Bagby will support a multi-million-dollar national marketing and advertising program in 1997 for its television and video products.
Zenith also manufactures display devices, network systems products and cable modems.
Zenith's stock was unchanged Tuesday afternoon at 12-1/2.
